The Audition Pal - Giveaway time! 🎭🥳🎉
Something New + Very Exciting! 🤩💛

We want to do something really special for our acting community, as a thank you for being part of the journey and supporting what we do ⭐🙌

We’re giving 1 lucky person the chance to win 3 free places in our future upcoming Casting Director workshops!! 🎉

These are just some of the incredible casting professionals we’ve worked with recently.

We’ve recently hosted workshops with casting professionals whose collective credits include projects for:

Netflix, Prime Video/Amazon, Disney+, BBC, ITV, Channel 4, HBO, Sky, Apple TV+, the History Channel + more! 🎬🔥

How to Enter:

1️⃣ Follow @theauditionpal on instagram 

2️⃣ Like the post

3️⃣ Tag 3 actor friends in the comments (counts as an additional entry)

4️⃣ Share the post to your story and tag us (for a bonus entry!)

This means you could get up to 3 entries! 🎉

Important Details 🚨

* Giveaway closes: October 16th, 23:59

* Winners announced: October 18th, 22:00

* Must be 18+ to enter

* Winners will be contacted via Instagram DM

Good luck everyone 🤍🎭

Seven Minutes
SEEKING ROLES:

Stella: depressed, Stella struggles to cope with the grief of living and finding a purpose in what life could be

Emory: Bubbly and optimistic, always tries to see the good in the bad. Attempts to get Stella to let her in more

Mom: Forgiving, just wants the best for her daughter and tries to show up in different ways

Paramedic: Quick on their feet, uses the best of their time.

Dominic: arrogant, goes about life in a way that he is the main character, very narcissistic

Unpaid Student film

We’re shooting from November 6th to the 8th. Potential pickups, the following week (TBD).

Logline: A depressed young woman gets into a tragic accident and is forced to confront her life in the span of seven minutes.

Contact: chloeewilson018@gmail.com if you’re interested

Hello again! Sorry for such short notice, BUT I am posting this casting call looking for some EXTRA's / BACKGROUND! We're shooting on old timey film, and I would love for scene to be lively with some people :). I attached some screen grabs from the rehearsal we did to show the look we're going for, except the real thing will be more authentic and not just me playing on Premiere haha.

I am mostly looking for someone to play a PARENT and a CHILD! They have this biggest part in interacting with the street mime. Everyone will be asked to run and clear frame at a certain point in the scene as well, so if you cannot run you might not want to come to this one.

*Compensation is copy of the footage (UPON REQUEST) and an IMDB Credit once the film is released :)

If you'd like to be a part of this, please email me :)

items.text:
The Patton Boys
SEEKING ROLES FOR A STUDENT SHORT FILM

Terry Patton: 19 - 23 Male
The younger brother of the teen detective duo, The Patton Boys. Terry is incredibly intelligent but keeps an innocent and naive spirit. An all-American kid, he likes his apples as crisp as he likes his pie sweet.

Wayne Patton: 19 - 23 Male
The older brother of the teen detective duo, The Patton Boys. Wayne is very protective over his brother and more aware of the evils of the world while still keeping a cheesy teen detective demeanor.

Mayor Beaufort: 30s - 60s Male
The jolly mayor of the small town of Skybrook. Beaufort greatly cares about his town and the people in it, especially The Patton Boys, who he feels very paternal towards. Beaufort has a very plotting mind, there are never not gears turning behind his rosy cheeks.

Please email jackson.g.brown@ucdenver.edu if interested

CASTING CALL- Chicago, IL 

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID PERFORMANCE OPPORTUNITIES

FlightTime Productions is pleased to announce its Final Open Casting Call for the upcoming world-premiere stage production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, scheduled to debut in Chicago in April 2027.

As we enter the final stages of casting, we are seeking talented, enthusiastic, and dedicated performers to join our growing theatrical company and help bring this exciting original production to life.

We welcome performers from diverse backgrounds and with varying levels of theatrical experience who meet the requirements of the available roles.

As the inaugural theatrical production of FlightTime Productions, Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall represents an exciting milestone for our company. Selected performers will have the opportunity to participate in a script read-through alongside the playwright, casting director, and members of our creative and production teams.

THIS IS AN OPEN CASTING CALL. NO APPOINTMENT OR ADVANCE REGISTRATION IS REQUIRED.

⸻

AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

Time: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Location:

West Loop Branch Library
Meeting Room
122 N. Aberdeen Street
Chicago, IL 60607

IMPORTANT CHECK-IN POLICY

Audition check-in will close promptly at 4:00 PM. All performers must arrive and complete check-in before this cutoff. Unfortunately, individuals arriving after 4:00 PM will not be permitted to audition.

We encourage performers to arrive early to allow sufficient time for registration and participation in the audition process.

Venue Disclaimer: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with, associated with, or a sponsor of FlightTime Productions or this theatrical production. The library serves solely as the location for this casting event.

⸻

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

All performers attending the open casting call should be prepared to demonstrate their acting abilities through both individual and collaborative exercises.

Prepared Monologue

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue of your choosing. Performers should select material that highlights their acting strengths, emotional range, characterization, and stage presence.

Group Improvisation Activities

In addition to prepared monologues, auditioning performers will participate in several group improvisational exercises facilitated by our casting team.

These activities are designed to evaluate creativity, spontaneity, listening skills, collaboration, comedic timing, and the ability to make confident character choices.

Previous improvisational experience is welcome but not required.

Required Audition Materials

All performers must bring:

* One current headshot
* One current acting résumé

Please bring physical copies of both documents for our casting team’s review.

⸻

CALLBACK INFORMATION

Performers selected for further consideration may be invited to attend our final callback session.

Friday, November 13, 2026

Start Time: 10:00 AM

Location:

Pullman Branch Library
11001 S. Indiana Avenue
Chicago, IL 60628

Callbacks are by invitation only.

Selected performers will receive additional instructions regarding their callback participation, including any required scene materials or character-specific preparation.

Please note that participation in the initial audition does not guarantee an invitation to callbacks or an offer of a role.

⸻

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama

Welcome aboard Diva Airways, where the turbulence isn’t just in the skies!

At Harvey International Airport, outspoken and fiercely determined airline owner Miss Loretta Monroe is fighting to keep her beloved airline flying high.

But behind the polished image of Diva Airways, trouble is brewing.

With mounting financial pressures, increasingly chaotic workplace operations, complicated family relationships, and a ruthless rival airline threatening everything she has worked to build, Loretta and her eccentric team find themselves facing the ultimate challenge: saving Diva Airways before it is too late.

As professional loyalties are tested, personal secrets come to light, and unexpected betrayals threaten to bring the company crashing down, the employees of Diva Airways must decide just how far they are willing to go to protect the airline they call home.

Blending sharp comedy with compelling drama, Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall explores ambition, loyalty, family, sacrifice, and the sometimes unpredictable cost of success.

Filled with outrageous workplace mishaps, unforgettable personalities, emotional confrontations, and heartfelt moments, this original theatrical production promises an entertaining and moving journey.

Fasten your seatbelts. This airline is in for one unforgettable ride!

⸻

AVAILABLE ROLES

We are currently casting the following two supporting roles. Both positions are paid performance opportunities.

COLIN

Supporting Role | Paid

Character Description:

Colin is Alexa Winters’ brother, a caring and family-oriented young man who makes an unexpected visit to his sister while awaiting his flight to Las Vegas.

Although his appearance may initially seem like an ordinary family visit, Colin brings an important emotional perspective to Alexa’s increasingly complicated life.

As tensions continue to build around Diva Airways, Colin reminds his sister of the importance of maintaining family connections, confronting unresolved feelings, and remembering what truly matters beyond the demands of work.

The performer portraying Colin should demonstrate strong emotional authenticity, natural conversational delivery, and the ability to balance lighthearted sibling interactions with sincere dramatic moments.

Role Requirements:

* Pronouns: He/Him
* Playing Age: 16+
* Ethnicity: Caucasian or Latino/Hispanic
* Performance Stipend: $800

TIFFANY BELMONT

Supporting Role | Paid

Character Description:

Tiffany Belmont is the personal assistant to Miss Brooks, the formidable owner of Diva Airways’ rival carrier, Backcountry Airlines.

New to the airline industry and still learning the finer points of corporate professionalism, Tiffany has a remarkable talent for finding herself in situations she does not entirely understand.

Her questionable fashion choices, limited situational awareness, and frequently misplaced confidence make her an unpredictable presence in Miss Brooks’ already demanding professional world.

Despite her best intentions, Tiffany often finds herself caught in the middle of workplace confusion, awkward misunderstandings, and the increasingly outrageous schemes surrounding Backcountry Airlines.

Working for a powerful and intimidating airline executive is certainly no easy assignment, especially when your boss might just be the devil wearing green!

The performer portraying Tiffany should possess excellent comedic instincts, expressive physicality, strong improvisational abilities, and a willingness to embrace the character’s delightfully awkward personality.

Role Requirements:

* Pronouns: She/Her
* Playing Age: 28+
* Ethnicity: Open to all ethnicities
* Performance Stipend: $800

All performers interested in joining the production should carefully review the anticipated rehearsal and performance schedule before auditioning.

Rehearsals Begin

Sunday, January 10, 2027

January – February 2027

Rehearsals are initially scheduled twice per week:

* Sundays — Generally during the afternoon
* Mondays — Generally during the evening

Beginning March 2027

Rehearsals are expected to increase to three times per week as the production approaches opening night:

* Sundays — Generally during the afternoon
* Mondays — Generally during the evening
* Tuesdays — Generally during the evening

Specific rehearsal times and locations will be communicated to cast members as the production schedule is finalized.

Technical Rehearsals

April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement

April 8 – May 30, 2027

Scheduled Performance Days: Thursday through Sunday

Performers must be prepared to commit to the required technical rehearsals and scheduled performances throughout the production engagement.

Potential Production Extension

An extension beyond May 30, 2027, may be considered based on audience demand, ticket sales, financial performance, and the overall success of the production.

Any proposed extension and associated performer commitments will be communicated to the cast in advance.

⸻

ADDITIONAL CASTING INFORMATION

FlightTime Productions is committed to creating a professional, collaborative, respectful, and welcoming theatrical environment for its performers and creative team.

As this production marks the company’s theatrical debut, we are particularly interested in working with performers who demonstrate reliability, enthusiasm, adaptability, and a genuine passion for live theater.

Casting decisions will be based on the requirements of each role, individual performance quality, character interpretation, chemistry, availability, and the overall needs of the production.

All roles advertised in this casting notice are non-union, paid opportunities, with the applicable performance stipend listed in each character description.

Further information regarding performer agreements, production expectations, and compensation terms will be provided to individuals offered roles.

⸻

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

For questions regarding auditions, available roles, callback procedures, or production commitments, please contact our casting team.

Email: divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please include Diva Airways Casting Inquiry in the subject line of your email.

⸻

READY TO TAKE THE STAGE?

Your next theatrical opportunity could be just one audition away!

Whether your strengths lie in comedy, drama, improvisation, or bringing unforgettable characters to life, FlightTime Productions welcomes you to showcase your talents at our Final Open Casting Call.

Come prepared with your monologue, bring your headshot and résumé, and be ready to demonstrate your creativity, personality, and performance skills.

Most importantly, come ready to have fun and show us what you can bring to the world of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall.

We sincerely appreciate the interest, time, and enthusiasm of every performer who considers auditioning for our inaugural production.

We look forward to meeting new talent, completing our exceptional cast, and embarking on this exciting theatrical journey together.

Thank you for your interest in FlightTime Productions. We look forward to seeing you on Monday, November 9, 2026!

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall
World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

Hi all!

I have recently been given the opportunity to produce a long time passion project of mine -  ‘last shot’

It is a sapphic romance and thriller short film - set in a retro-futuristic world. Filming will take place in Cheltenham and Gloucester around early to late November this year (dates to be decided). Travel expenses will be covered and food will be provided.

If you are interested please email me at emmamgfilm@gmail.com and or send me a message through here 🙏 alongside please list your availability in November 

Thanks, Emma :)

.
.
.
.
.
Jonny sends Vinni to "sort him out" after a guy has been getting too loud.

Vinni comes back thinking he's done exactly what he was asked to do. Jonny has a very different idea of what "sort him out" means.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Pilne!!!

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Kobieta — 18-20 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Wygląd nastolatki. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 65-85 lat

Senior o siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 20-25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową!

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

sharedPost.text:
**Suche eine Sängerin**

Suche eine Sängerin(gerne auch Amateurin) für ein Hobby-Projekt.

Ich biete die Musik, die Texte und die Aufnahmemöglichkeit,

du die Stimme und die Interpretation.

Voraussetzung dafür wäre eine erweiterte räumliche Nähe zu Großhansdorf, um sich regelmäßig treffen zu können.

Es handelt sich um englische Songs in Richtung Jazzpopp, auch mal etwas bluesisch. Wäre schön, von dir zu hören. LG Werner

Hi everyone,

As part of a project with Luca School of Arts, we flemish students are collaborating with up-and-coming artists to create a music video for them. We’re still looking for two actors to help us on October 16 and 17 in Brussels. The song is “Hou mij tegen” by “Floris Francis Arthur,” and the story is (in short) about a couple who drift apart after a miscarriage. If you’re interested, I’ll send you more information.

�So we’re looking for a man and a woman who look to be around 30–32 years old.

If you’re interested, feel free to send me a message. You can also call me anytime at +32 471 03 09 43 or send an email to margodefrancq@gmail.com

Best regards,

Margo Defrancq

Hello everyone! 🥀
How often do you document yourself, the places you live, and the moments that make you who you are?

I am a photographer focusing on portraiture, visual storytelling, and analog photography📸

Throughout October & November, I’m dedicating more time to analog photography and would love to collaborate with artists and event organisers, documenting your performances and events, as well as creating artistic and personal portraits.

Available for performance documentation, event photography, and outdoor analog portrait sessions in Berlin & Hamburg.

Feel free to reach out here or via Instagram @zakharin.photography.

I.Z.

🎬 CASTING CALL — THE NEIGHBOUR

We are currently casting for our upcoming short film **THE NEIGHBOUR**, a psychological drama about a reclusive woman whose carefully hidden past is disrupted when a young girl from next door discovers her secret.

🎭 **ROLES:**

**GRETCHEN - Female, 60s**
A reclusive woman who has spent decades disappearing from the world. After a troubled childhood and a life built around staying unseen, a young girl begins to break through her walls.

**PIXIE - Any Gender, 10–14**
A sharp, observant kid who acts like she has everything figured out. Behind her tough exterior, she is simply looking for someone to step in and protect her.

**ANNIE - Female, 30s**

Bio: Despite being a card carrying lesbian you wouldn't know to look at her and many men do much to the annoyance of her partner who also works at the depot. 

We look forward to hopefully working with you and welcoming you to the Fandio & On The Coaches family!

items.text: How much should babies make for a background role but will be the main character baby

topComments.text: It’s usually sa rate babies get paid

My son played the lead baby double on a tv show once. We were booked for general bg then the lead baby freaked out and my son was pulled in as her stand in. Yes, he played a girl. Joy to babies who can look both ways lol

But it all depends on how they hired the baby in the first place. The baby on the show was hired in as core BG, I believe, so my son was still paid as BG. 

In our experience, and we have not really done background for the last 4/5 years, kids bg are usually hired on SAG vouchers (but do not have to count for membership).

Background is still paid as BG unless you were specifically bumped, then its a whole contract thing. If its a studio project, it will be prevailing SAG BG rate for the day. If its not studio, or outside of CA, or not SAG… well, thats the wild wild west and no one can answer that for you.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL!
Hi! I’m Fé from Just Russel 👋

Just Russel is a Belgian brand that creates personalised food for dogs and cats. 🐶🐱

We’re currently looking for new faces in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and France who enjoy being in front of the camera.

For our videos, we’re looking for people who feel comfortable on camera and enjoy creating fun, natural content.

You don’t need to have a pet yourself, we can provide one for the shoot. 😉 But if you do have a four-legged friend who also enjoys being in front of the camera, they’re more than welcome to join!

The most important thing is that you feel comfortable on camera and with an animal by your side on set.

Would you like to be part of our content?

Just fill in the form and who knows, maybe we’ll see you on set soon! 🎥

Hi all!

I have recently been given the opportunity to produce a long time passion project of mine -  ‘last shot’

It is a sapphic romance and thriller short film - set in a retro-futuristic world. Filming will take place in Cheltenham and Gloucester around early to end of November this year (dates to be decided). Travel expenses will be covered and food will be provided.

If you are interested please email me at emmamgfilm@gmail.com and or send me a message through here 🙏 alongside please list your availability in November 

Thanks, Emma :)

**CASTING **

We are looking for actors for roles in a recurring True Crime Documentary series on Sky Crime, filming Wednesday 14th and Thursday 15th October 2026 in Southampton.

**Must be able to travel to Southampton on both days.**

**ROLES:**

Black Male - 40-50yo - Bald - Some Facial Hair preferable. Large Build.

Black Female - 40-50yo - Dark hair

Paid roles up to £150 per day depending on hours on set.

If you are interested please email jonathan.hutchings@woodcutmedia.com with your details and a photo of yourself for further information

Thanks!

🎬 CASTING – 2 AKTORÓW / MODELI (18+)

Szukam dziewczyny i chłopaka (18+) do zdjęcia okładkowego do albumu muzycznego. 📸🎶

📍 Lokalizacja: Warszawa
💋 Sesja będzie obejmowała pocałunek między osobami występującymi na zdjęciu.

Ważne, żeby osoby zgłaszające się nie miały nic przeciwko temu, że finalne zdjęcie zostanie wykorzystane jako okładka albumu muzycznego i będzie publicznie dostępne.

💰 Wynagrodzenie: szczegóły i stawka w wiadomości prywatnej.

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowana/y, napisz komentarz, odezwę się prywatnie ! Będę prosić o podesłanie kilku zdjęć i krótką informację o sobie.

REKLAMA / WARSZAWA / STATYŚCI
Poszukujemy statystów chętnych do wzięcia udziału w reklamie! (oferta płatna💸💸)

🗓️Kiedy i gdzie?

📍Teatr RELAX - Warszawa ul. Złota 8

▪️Czwartek 15 października 

▪️Wstępnie: 9:30-13:00

Kogo szukamy?

▪️3 panie w wieku ok. 35 lat

▪️3 panowie w wieku ok. 35 lat

▪️4 panie w wieku ok. 60-65 lat

▪️4 panowie w wieku ok. 60-65 lat

Wymogi:

- dostosowany ubiór pod realizację dwóch scen 

a) elegancki (ale nie przesadnie) na świąteczne wyjście do teatru - np. sweterek/marynarka w kolorach CZARNY, GARANTOWY, SZARY BEŻOWY ‼️

b) luźniejszy, na wyjście na koncert (wyobraźcie sobie koncert Lady Pank) - t-shirt, kurtka skórzana etc.‼️

Oczywiście prosimy o ubrania nie zawierające widocznych logotypów. ‼️

Oferta płatna - wynagrodzenie 100 złotych wręczane na planie. 💸💸

Osoby zainteresowane współpracą proszę o przesłanie wiadomości (imię, nazwisko, wiek, numer telefonu) oraz aktualnej fotografii biometrycznej na adres mailowy: 

zuza.kubanska.prod@gmail.com💌

Do zobaczenia na planie!👋

This job requires proficient English.

This is a job opportunity in Alhambra involving training AI to perform simple, everyday tasks. 

You’ll be doing a variety of hands-on activities, such as cooking, chopping vegetables, preparing food, assembling items, screwing something into a wall, and other basic household tasks.

Everything will be directed step by step, so you don’t need any special skills or prior experience. You’ll simply follow instructions and demonstrate the tasks as directed.

The work is straightforward, and the activities may vary from day to day.

🎭 **Warszawa i Kielce szukają Kelly!**

Teatr Ochoty szuka **aktorki w wieku 18–25 lat** do roli tytułowej w spektaklu **„Kelly // Kelly kontra Big Tech”** w reżyserii Justyny Sobczyk.

🎬 **Wykształcenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane**, ale potrzebne jest doświadczenie sceniczne.

📍 Prace nad spektaklem będą odbywać się przede wszystkim w **Teatrze im. Stefana Żeromskiego w Kielcach**, od **12 stycznia do 13 marca 2027**. Powstaną dwie autonomiczne części spektaklu – warszawska i kielecka – a Kelly pozostanie tą samą osobą w obu.

**Co trzeba wysłać?**
• CV
• krótką informację o doświadczeniu artystycznym lub portfolio
• krótkie nagranie castingowe (ok. 1,5 min), w którym jesteś Kelly podczas streamu
• kilka słów o tym, co interesuje Cię w temacie spektaklu

Nie szukamy gotowej interpretacji postaci – chcemy zobaczyć, jak ją badasz. Telefon w zupełności wystarczy.

📅 **Zgłoszenia do 27.10 do końca dnia**

👉 **FORMULARZ:** [https://forms.gle/xUH9CjW3i3XmzXmm7](https://forms.gle/xUH9CjW3i3XmzXmm7)

II etap odbędzie się **1, 2 lub 3 grudnia w Teatrze Ochoty w Warszawie** i będzie miał formę stacjonarnych warsztatów.

Jeśli znacie kogoś, kto może być Kelly — **podeślijcie dalej!**

https://fb.me/e/27YWzljsdz 🟢

**Zdjęcia:** długoterminowy projekt, ok. 2 kampanie miesięcznie

• Bardzo swobodny w kontakcie z obcymi osobami na ulicy

CASTING CALL FOR MODELS/ACTORS - UNPAID STUDENT SHORT
‘Bloom’ is a poetic documentary, exploring the reality of women living with debilitating menstrual conditions, and the medical misogyny leaving their pain overlooked. 

We are looking for a female - presenting model or actress who would be interested in helping us to create some recreational scenes for visuals within the documentary. 

The role would be no dialogue (mainly mime and body language)

Please note that because this is a student short, the budget is unfortunately small so the role will be unpaid however travel and food will be provided. 

If you are interested, please reach out either via email or mobile (featured in the poster above!)

items.text: Hi my daughter age 14 has been in acting classes for a few years now and wants to cast, where’s the best place to start or look please?

topComments.text:
You can join sites like Mandy and keep an eye out for open castings for lower budget Indie films etc but be vigilant, do your due diligence and ensure it is properly licensed.
The vast majority of professional work is cast via Spotlight for which she needs an agent. Unfortunately age 14 is pretty much the worst age to try to start and it may be better to wait until after GCSES and things pick up a little, agencies may be more receptive etc... right now unless she is tiny and looks young so could pass for age 11 there are very few opportunities indeed especially without previous experience and agencies already have their books full of teens who have been doing it for years all chasing very few opportunities... It costs at least £300 per year to have Spotlight and Headshots before any other costs... It is also generally very quiet in the industry... My 14 year old has lots of experience but auditions are more and more rare.

It's a really tough age as a teen coupled with it being really quiet at the moment.  Can check out open castings on instagram or sites like Mandy but finding an agent gives best chance.  Needs to be looking as young as possible

Shooting in London on the 26th of October. £500 payment for lead coach role and £300 payment per player. Please e-mail erica.stein@ladbiblegroup.com if interested. Thanks!

***On recherche un comédien en vue du rôle principal masculin, 20-25 ans, pour un clip musical étudiant à Angers (Pays de la Loire, France)***
# 
**Le projet** : 

Clip musical appelé « Ok Ok Ok » du groupe "Fleuri Désert"
# 
**Cadre **: 

Projet pédagogique d'étudiants en Bachelor Réalisateur Monteur de l'école Studio M Angers.
# 
**Date du tournage **: 

Samedi 24 octobre 2026, journée et soirée, à Angers 
# 
⚠️ ***non défrayé*** ⚠️

**LE RÔLE **

Rôle principal, muet. Un jeune homme dont la vie lui échappe : il rate un rendez-vous avec une fille, puis un rendez-vous avec un employeur, et chaque échec l'enfonce un peu plus. Il en souffre, et ça doit se voir.
Le personnage met en images les paroles de la chanson. Tout passe par le visage, le corps et les réactions. Le ton est très théâtrale, presque exagéré par moment tout en étant capable de transmettre des émotions forte à d'autre moment. On cherche donc idéalement quelqu'un capable de jouer un personnage désemparé et d'aller loin dans l'expression sans que ça sonne faux.
Pas de danse
# 
PROFIL 

Homme, 20 à 25 ans.
À l'aise avec le jeu expressif et physique. Une expérience en théâtre, impro ou tournage est un plus.
# 
INFOS PRATIQUES

Il faut être disponible toute la journée et la soirée du samedi 24 octobre, à Angers (49).

# CANDIDATURE 

Par mail à [goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628)
***Objet obligatoire : Casting Clip musical*** (car on recherche pour plusieurs projets en ce moment)
Joindre : une photo récente (visage et plein pied), votre âge, votre ville, et si possible un lien vers une vidéo de jeu.
Date limite : 14 octobre 2026

Clap&Light Productions ([goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628))

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

অপেক্ষা... শুধু অপেক্ষা!
অপেক্ষা হ্যাঁ, অপেক্ষা নিয়েই তো বসে আছি আমি। কিন্তু কার অপেক্ষা?
না, আমার কোনো প্রেমিকা নেই। তার অপেক্ষায় বসে নেই আমি। আমি তো অবিবাহিত, তাই স্ত্রীর অপেক্ষা করারও প্রশ্ন ওঠে না। তাহলে কার অপেক্ষা?
বন্ধু? দূর! এই বয়সে নতুন করে বন্ধুত্ব করার মানুষই বা কোথায়? যাঁদের বন্ধু বলে জানি, তাঁরা সবাই নিজেদের সংসার নিয়ে ব্যস্ত।
তাহলে?
আমি অপেক্ষা করছি কাজের। একজন শিল্পী হিসেবে নিজের কাজের।
অপেক্ষা... শুধু অপেক্ষা...

BALLET VATAN

INTERNATIONAL CALL FOR CHOREOGRAPHERS | 2027

BALLET VATAN Production invites professional choreographers to apply for its 2027 season projects.

Professional Requirements

* Proven experience in choreography for professional stage productions and live entertainment.
* Ability to work closely with a stage director and bring a shared artistic vision to life.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively alongside other choreographers.
* Experience creating original choreography for stage shows and live performances.
* Versatility across different dance styles and performance genres.
* Ability to lead rehearsals, work with professional dance ensembles, and meet production deadlines.
* Creativity, professionalism, adaptability, and a strong team-oriented mindset.

Application Requirements

Applicants are requested to submit:

1. An up-to-date professional CV outlining relevant experience and previous projects.
2. A video portfolio showcasing original choreographic work (YouTube, Vimeo, or other accessible links).
3. A brief description of their specific creative responsibilities in the submitted productions.

Applications

Email: 2027casting@gmail.com

Subject: Choreographer – BALLET VATAN 2027

We welcome applications from experienced choreographers interested in contributing to international stage productions and live entertainment projects.

BALLET VATAN Production

CALL FOR PLAYWRIGHTS

Our production company is currently looking for an original play for 3–4 actors with no restrictions on age or gender.

We are particularly interested in stories with a strong psychological context, intriguing characters, and preferably an element of mystery, suspense, or unexpected twists

If you are a playwright with a story that could be suitable, please send me:

• A short synopsis of your play
• The number of actors/characters
• Your proposed terms for licensing or acquiring the author’s rights
• Your email address and/or phone number

Based on the synopsis, we will review the material and contact selected writers directly to discuss the project and potential collaboration.

We are looking for original, engaging stories with strong theatrical potential.

📩 We look forward to hearing from you!

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

topComments.text: Oh my goodness, this sounds like so much fun. I wish I was available.

MATILDA COUTURE by MY LITTLE MATILDA invites MALE & FEMALE MODELS OF ALL AGES to join our spectacular Christmas Gala Runway Show Experience! And yes! It is going to be our magical red collection! ❤️

❤️ Date: November 14, 2026
❤️ Time: 5:00 PM
❤️ Venue: Caribe Royale Orlando, Florida
❤️ Production: Orlando International Fashion Week

✨ RUNWAY EXPERIENCE INCLUDES:
👗 Elegant designer outfit to keep after the show
📸 Professional runway photography
💄 Hair & Makeup
👑 Runway experience
📰 Feature in Matilda Model Magazine

👑 PAGEANT QUEENS & KINGS WELCOME!

Models holding pageant titles are welcome to wear their official crowns and sashes during our special carousel lineup to proudly represent their titles!

🌟 Open to beginners and experienced models, children, teens, and adults!

Garment fee applies. This is a pay-to-participate runway experience, not a paid modeling job.

🎄 Celebrate the magic of Christmas, fashion, and confidence on the runway!

📩 DM US TO REGISTER! LIMITED SPOTS AVAILABLE!

sharedPost.text:
🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Dr. Meike Lauggas über die Möglichkeit des Miteinander-Sprechens um schwierige Situationen zu verarbeiten. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 176. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
 🗓️ Dienstag, 13.10.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
 🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Förderung und Verwertung in Österreich 
 🎙️ Emanuel Treu 
 🎤 Moderation: Michael Weilguny 

Welche Fördermöglichkeiten stehen Musikschaffenden in Österreich zur Verfügung? Was ist bei Anträgen zu beachten – und welche typischen Fehler lassen sich vermeiden? 

Der international tätige Songwriter und Musiker, Coach und Buchautor Emanuel Treu gibt einen kompakten Überblick über Projektförderungen, Stipendien und langfristige Unterstützungsangebote. Als Vorstandsmitglied der AKM beleuchtet er außerdem das Thema „Money-In“: Wie funktioniert die Verwertung eigener Werke konkret, welche Rolle spielen AKM, VOET & Co. – und wie können Musikschaffende sicherstellen, dass ihr kreatives Schaffen auch finanziell wirksam wird? 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die Fördermöglichkeiten gezielter nutzen, ihre Anträge überzeugend gestalten und ihre Rechte sowie finanziellen Chancen als Musikschaffende besser verstehen möchten. 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/7qZOEkrz6

ATLANTA, GEORGIA 2012 : JAMIE MATTHEWS, An Actor and EX - Special Operations Soldier who plays SOLDIER MAN, A Major Superhero On The Big Screen, is on The Run from “TOWERS STUDIOS”, A Corrupt Atlanta Movie Studio, and must use his special set of skills to survive the tactics of the studios’ various agents and it’s Deadliest Assassins, while trying to reclaim his life. 

THE SOLDIER MAN CINEMATIC UNIVERSE :

ATLANTA, GEORGIA 2050 : After Receiving Superhuman Powers From an Extraterrestrial Asteroid Fragment, SOLDIER MAN embraces his Destiny Of Protecting The City Of Atlanta against Superhuman Villains, who were also given their Powers from The Same Astroid.

Realizing his Extraordinary Powers, and his determination to use them for Good, Soldier Man gets Recruited into The ZION SOCIETY, An Advanced, Hi - Tech Atlanta Based Secret Agency that employs and trains Super-humans to become Secret Agents who Takedown Superhuman Criminals who pose as a Threat to Both The City Of Atlanta And To The World. 

Towers Created By April Wynn - Morrison. 

Graphic Novel By Russell Rainey.

**Tworzymy czułą przestrzeń twórczą, dla Twojego dziecka, na Mokotowie!**

**Mała Akademia Teatralna **Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na moich zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Pamiętam, czego mi brakowało, kiedy jako dziecko uczyłam się teatru. I właśnie to - daję teraz dzieciom.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej o naszych warsztatach artystycznych i twórczej działalności, odwiedź naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/tworcze-przestrzenie

albo stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Możesz też do nas napisać na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Zapraszamy na zajęcia w najbliższy wtorek! Dołącz do Drużyny Czułego Teatru!

13.10 kobiet i mężczyzn jako Patrioci śpiewający piosenki patriotyczne. Osoby mówiące biegle po polsku

14.10 kobiet, mężczyzn i dzieci. Różny wiek i wygląd.

Obowiązkowe przymairki 12.10 na Mokotowie 

Stała łączna 170zl netto
Dzieci 250zl netto
Płatne gotówką

Dzieci tylko z aktualnymi zgodami PIP

Zgłoszenia na maila
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com 

Tytuł data dyspozycyjności

W treści podaj
- aktualne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.
Panowie zdjęcie boku fryzury. Kobiety włosy rozpuszczone i bez makijażu
- imię i nazwisko
- wiek i wzrost
- info o tatuażach i aparatach na zębach
- nr tel

**WARSZAWA**

**12 / 13 / 14 / 15 października**

**Serial fabularny KB**

**Stawka 130 zł gotówką**

** **

Skoro fabuła naszego serialu nie opiera się na zasadach gry fair play, nie mogło zabraknąć szpitala ;) Przenosimy się więc tam i szukamy chętnych Statystów:

** **

**12-15 PAŹDZIERNIKA (poniedziałek-czwartek):**

Gramy w szpitalu na Działdowskiej.

**- PERSONEL MEDYCZNY / PACJENCI **– wiek i płeć zróżnicowane.

- **STUDENCI MEDYCYNY **– wiek ok. 18-25 lat. **Tylko 12.10**.

Nie szukam kontynuacji. Można zgłaszać się na 1 dzień lub więcej.

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB+dzień, który Wam odpowiada**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

**Casting Call: 3 Actors for Security-Awareness Videos | Berlin**

We're looking for three Berlin-based actors for a series of 21 short security-awareness training videos for a large cybersecurity company.

**Who we're looking for:**
* Fluent English with a neutral American accent.
* A professional, approachable presence. Open to different ages and backgrounds.
* Natural, expressive delivery with personality - comfortable bringing curiosity, concern, surprise and urgency to educational content.
* We're aiming for a diverse cast, ideally two women and one man.

**Shoot details:**
* One full shoot day in Berlin, date TBC.
* Each actor will present several videos within the series.
* Paid project. Fee and usage terms to be agreed before booking.

**Szukamy osób do krótkiego nagrania na social media!**

Poszukujemy osób do udziału w rolce promującej kabanosy. Nagranie będzie miało formę krótkiej, swobodnej sondy – do powiedzenia będą dosłownie 1–2 zdania na temat produktu i pokazanie naturalnej, pozytywnej reakcji na jego otrzymanie.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia przed kamerą, zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności i swobodzie wypowiedzi.

**Wynagrodzenie: 80 zł za ok. 30 minut.**

📍 Miejsce: Wrocław
📅 Termin: 13–15 października, w godzinach 11:00–15:00 (do uzgodnienia)

Przed nagraniem konieczne będzie podpisanie zgody na wykorzystanie wizerunku w materiałach publikowanych w mediach społecznościowych marki.

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną wraz z aktualnym zdjęciem.

18 października o 17:00 Teatr Nowe Formy zamieni się w miejsce pełne teatralnych eksperymentów, twórczej odwagi i… mafijnej elegancji! 😎
To wieczór improwizacji w mafijnym stylu! 

Tym razem spotykamy się nie tylko po to, żeby wspólnie improwizować, ale też lepiej się poznać, pobyć razem i dać się ponieść kreatywności!

▪️◾️▪️ 
CO NAS CZEKA?
✨ Aktorskie ćwiczenia improwizacyjne
😂 Zabawne scenki i teatralne niespodzianki
🎤 OTWARTY MIKROFON – czyli scena dla Ciebie!
❤️ Dużo dobrej energii, rozmów i wspólnej zabawy

🎤 TERAZ TWOJA KOLEJ, BY WEJŚĆ NA SCENĘ!

Masz w szufladzie wiersz? Pomysł na stand-up? Chcesz zaśpiewać, przeczytać fragment prozy albo pokazać własną etiudę?
▪️◾️▪️

Dajemy Ci prawdziwą teatralną scenę i publiczność, która będzie Ci kibicować! ❤️

A do tego wsparcie i konstruktywną informację zwrotną od profesjonalistów związanych z teatrem.

Bez oceniania, konkursów i castingów. Za to z przestrzenią na eksperymentowanie, przełamywanie tremy i odkrywanie własnych możliwości.

▪️◾️▪️
👉 Chcesz wystąpić? Wypełnij krótki formularz zgłoszeniowy i opowiedz nam o swoim pomyśle. (link w komentarzu) 

Wolisz zostać na widowni? Też wspaniale! Możesz po prostu przyjść, improwizować z nami, śmiać się i kibicować innym.

🎩 DRESS CODE: MAFIJNA ELEGANCJA!
Garnitur, kapelusz, sukienka lub jeden stylowy dodatek. Poczuj klimat „Ojca chrzestnego”!

📅 18 października | 17:00
📍 Teatr Nowe Formy, Warszawa
🎟️ Uczestnicy naszych kursów – wstęp bezpłatny
🎟️ Goście – 50 zł
bilety dostepne na noweformy.org/repertuar 
Na miejscu czeka na Was również nasz teatralny bar 😉 

▪️◾️▪️
Zabierz przyjaciół, znajomych i wszystkich, którzy mają ochotę spędzić z nami nieco szalony, twórczy wieczór.

Bo w naszej teatralnej rodzinie zawsze znajdzie się miejsce dla kogoś nowego! ❤️

▪️◾️▪️
Gdy zobaczysz ten znak ->▪️◾️▪️weź świadomy i pogłębiony wdech.
#RodzinaImpro #TeatrNoweFormy #Improwizacja #teatr

CALL FOR CASTING & DIRECTOR
🎬🕴🏾

Production: The Reckoning (Independent Stage Play / One-Person Show)

Location: High Wycombe Community Centre

Rehearsal / Performance Times: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM (3-Day Duration)

Compensation: Unpaid role (Volunteer / Amateur Dramatics) with potential earnings once showcased. Travel costs covered, drinks supplied,(including paid meal cover if sessions run past the scheduled time).

Contact: Jen Jennie68grace@gmail.com

1. ACTOR CASTING CALL

Role: Lead Performer (One-Person Show)

Gender / Ethnicity: Black Female (Adult)age 30-40

Type: Amateur / Community Theatre

About the Role:

We are seeking a versatile Black adult female actor for a compelling, single-performer stage play set entirely within a courtroom. The performer will embody a range of younger characters, tracing the journey of a child transitioning into adulthood while processing childhood trauma.

This production explores how unaddressed trauma shapes us and the painful reality of growing up without formal justice or closure. Please note that this play is non-graphic the material handles these sensitive themes in a subtle, nuanced, and emotionally grounded way without explicit or graphic depictions.

Key Requirements:

 * Ability to play and transition between multiple younger character perspectives.

* Strong physical and vocal versatility to convey age, innocence, and emotional weight in a non-graphic manner.

* Commitment to exploring challenging themes with care, authenticity, and resilience.

Logistics & Perks:

 * Venue: High Wycombe Community Centre

 * Schedule: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM over 3 days

 * Terms: Unpaid initial project, with future profit-share/earning potential once the show is showcased.

* Expenses & Refreshments: Travel costs will be covered, drinks supplied,. If sessions run over the allotted hour/time, food will be fully paid for.

2. DIRECTOR CALL🎬🕴️

📞 

Role: Stage Director

Type: Amateur / Independent Theatre

About the Project:

We are searching for a director who is unafraid to tackle sensitive, high-stakes subject matter. The ideal director will have a strong eye for physical staging within a courtroom setting, a collaborative approach to actor coaching, and the confidence to guide a delicate story about childhood trauma, memory, and the search for justice in a non-graphic, visually powerful way.

Key Responsibilities:

 * Lead staging and character development for a dynamic one-person production.

* Help shape the emotional pacing and non-graphic transitions between different character ages.

* Create a safe, supportive, and brave creative space for the performer while handling sensitive themes responsibly.

Logistics & Perks:

 * Venue: High Wycombe Community Centre

* Schedule: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM over 3 days

 * Terms: Unpaid initial role with potential earnings upon showcasing.

* Expenses & Refreshments: 

Travel costs will be covered, drinks supplied. If sessions run over the allotted hour/time, food will be fully paid for.

HOW TO APPLY / GET IN TOUCH

If you are interested in auditioning for the role or applying to direct 

The Reckoning, please reach out to Jen with a brief introduction or your creative background.

 * Email: Jennie68grace@gmail.com

🎬 CALLING ALL CINEMATOGRAPHERS & CAMERA OPERATORS! 🎥
Paid Opportunity | £150 | Half-Day Shoot

I’m looking for a talented cinematographer to collaborate with me on a cinematic showreel project inspired by the world of Tom Hardy’s portrayal of Ronnie Kray.

📍 Location: Shepton Mallet Prison

📅 Shoot date: 6th November 2026

💷 Pay: £150

⏳ Application deadline: 30th October 2026

🎬 THE PROJECT

We’re creating a dark, gritty, intense prison-based showreel, with a scene featuring dialogue inside a prison cell. We’re looking to capture a cinematic atmosphere with strong visuals, lighting and storytelling.

🎥 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has their own camera and filming equipment.

* Can travel to Shepton Mallet Prison.

* Is happy to collaborate with me on a half-day shoot.

* Has a creative eye for cinematic visuals and storytelling.

Extra skills that would be a big bonus:

* Basic lighting setup and advice.

* Post-production knowledge and guidance.

* Experience creating cinematic, dramatic or gritty visuals.

Having your own camera is essential, but priority will be given to cinematographers who can also offer advice on lighting and post-production.

This is a chance to collaborate on a creative project in a unique prison setting and help bring a dark, character-driven scene to life.

📩 INTERESTED?

Send me a message on Facebook Messenger or email:

📧 Arthur.Davidhill@jocular.media

Please include a little about yourself, the camera and equipment you use, show reel link with would great to please

items.summary:
🎬 CALLING ALL CINEMATOGRAPHERS & CAMERA OPERATORS! 🎥
Paid Opportunity | £150 | Half-Day Shoot

I’m looking for a talented cinematographer to collaborate with me on a cinematic showreel project inspired by the world of Tom Hardy’s portrayal of Ronnie Kray.

📍 Location: Shepton Mallet Prison

📅 Shoot date: 6th November 2026

💷 Pay: £150

⏳ Application deadline: 30th October 2026

🎬 THE PROJECT

We’re creating a dark, gritty, intense prison-based showreel, with a scene featuring dialogue inside a prison cell. We’re looking to capture a cinematic atmosphere with strong visuals, lighting and storytelling.

🎥 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has their own camera and filming equipment.

* Can travel to Shepton Mallet Prison.

* Is happy to collaborate with me on a half-day shoot.

* Has a creative eye for cinematic visuals and storytelling.

Extra skills that would be a big bonus:

* Basic lighting setup and advice.

* Post-production knowledge and guidance.

* Experience creating cinematic, dramatic or gritty visuals.

Having your own camera is essential, but priority will be given to cinematographers who can also offer advice on lighting and post-production.

This is a chance to collaborate on a creative project in a unique prison setting and help bring a dark, character-driven scene to life.

📩 INTERESTED?

Send me a message on Facebook Messenger or email:

📧 Arthur.Davidhill@jocular.media

Please include a little about yourself, the camera and equipment you use, show reel link with would great to please 

Application deadline: 30th October 2026.

Feel free to share this post or tag someone who might be a great fit!

🎥 SØGER 10 PIGER (18–30 ÅR) TIL YOUTUBE-VIDEO PÅ SØNDAG – VIND 1.000 KR.
Hej! Vi er Chris og Jacob,

Vi søger 10 unge piger til en YouTube-video på søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15–18 på Amager.

Vi skal filme en sjov generalviden-quiz (pige-edition), hvor Jacob og jeg er værter, og 10 piger konkurrerer mod hinanden om 1.000 kr.

Deltagelsen er ulønnet, men vinderen får 1.000 kr. i præmie.

Hvordan fungerer det?

Alle 10 piger starter sammen. Vi stiller spørgsmål om alt muligt, både nemme spørgsmål, pigeting og lidt mærkelige og sjove spørgsmål.

Det gælder om at svare hurtigst rigtigt. Den første, der svarer rigtigt, er videre til næste runde og træder ud af gruppen. Så er der 9 tilbage, og vi stiller et nyt spørgsmål. Sådan fortsætter det, indtil den sidste person er tilbage og ryger ud.

Derefter starter vi igen med 9 piger, så 8, 7 osv., indtil vi har 2 finalister, der skal dyste om 1.000 kr. i finalen.

Det hele bliver filmet med flere kameraer i et studie på Amager og lagt op på vores YouTube-kanal.

Vi har sat kl. 15–18 af for at være på den sikre side, men det kommer højst sandsynligt til at tage kortere tid.

På billederne kan I se referencer til, hvordan kameraopsætningen og vinklerne kommer til at se ud, samt selve studiet, vi skal filme i.

Vi søger bare unge piger (18–30 år), der har lyst til at være med og have det sjovt. Man behøver hverken have erfaring foran et kamera eller være ekspert i generalviden, da det simple spg alle kan være med i og ikke en intelligens test.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, eller du vil høre mere, så skriv en SMS til mig på 23 29 87 88 eller på Instagram: christophermarcc

Håber nogle har lyst til at være med! 😄

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

items.text:
CASTING CALL: Out, Amongst the Stars

Project Type: Independent feature film

Genre: Sci-fi, Adventure

Tone: Character-driven, dialogue-heavy and incorporating visual effects.

Production Dates: TBC late October-November-December 2026

Location: Leeds and surrounding West Yorkshire area, UK

Pay Rate: Voluntary only. Complimentary copy of the completed film. Cast members can extract their scenes for Showreel purposes from the completed film. Gala screening invite.

Stills, BTS and editorial coverage where possible. The film will be listed on IMDB.

Auditions: To be held in Leeds.

PROJECT SYNOPSIS: 

Forty-six years ago, amid rumours of UFO sightings and government cover-ups, an ordinary family man vanished without a trace. Abi, his now middle-aged daughter, uncovers a truth no one wanted to face – that there was an extraterrestrial visitation, her father's disappearance was no accident, and for reasons still unknown, whatever took him is about to return...

Production scope overview:

Out, Amongst The Stars is the sixth feature film from production company WOTR. This is a microbudget feature film to shoot mainly in Leeds and the surrounding West Yorkshire area.

We are only considering cast who have a base in the region. The main shoot will be approximately 5 weeks, Mondays to Fridays. The completed film will be sent to film festivals and streaming services. The film has a large cast contingent, so other casting notices will follow.

LEAD ROLES:

-Dr. Abi Sherwood (daughter)

Age Range: late 40s to early 50s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: British White

Character Description: Grounded. Very intelligent, relatable. Science nerd. Dry

sense of humour. Caring. Joyous.

-Usman (scientist, colleague, friend)

Age Range: late 30s to 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Black Asian

Character Description: GSOH, dependable, smart, witty. Sincere.

-Sergei (scientist)

Age Range: 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White (Slavic/Russian)

Character Description: Rugged, inquisitive nature, academic, kind

-Evi Sherwood (mother)

Age Range: Late 60s to 70s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Weary, reclusive, academic, drinking issues.

-Adam Sherwood (father)

Age Range: Late 30 to early 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Good natured, caring, academic

-Chandraneethan (Theoretical mathematician and Physicist)

Age Range: Late 20s to 30s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Indian Asian

Character Description: Confident, gifted Scientist

-Audrey Park (Retired business woman, Wife)

Age Range: Late 50s to 60s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: Open

Character Description: Stalwart, distraught by events

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS

Please send the following to [bristylecoaching@outlook.com] with the subject line: [CHARACTER NAME]: [YOUR NAME] - Out, Amogst the Stars Casting Call

-Current Headshot & Resume (PDF format)

-Demo Reel or Video Clip link (Spotlight)

-City/State where you are currently based

I look forward to connecting with You!

With Love & Health,

Bri Miller (Casting Director)

For more information and introductions about our project, please visit: https://www.facebook.com/OutAmongstTheStars
items.previewDescription: Produced by  northern UK based film production company WOTR.

topComments.text:
Unfortunately, I’m not in the UK.  Sounds like a fun shoot. 
I wanted to thank you for explaining that reel footage is not actually provided, but can be extracted from the finished product. My experience has been that almost all independent films promise footage and don’t then provide it. It’s rare to be actually sent reel footage and rare to be told up front that you’ll have to clip it. So, I appreciate the honesty. Wish I could be there.

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję mężczyzn do nastepujących ról:
 
1.Sebastian (27) – kierownik kawiarni, szczupły, przystojny i zadbany. Pozytywny gość. 
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

2.Miłosz (46) – adopcyjny ojciec Roksany, przeciętny facet zniszczony życiem, w depresji.  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3.Diler (27) – cwaniakowaty diler, łysy, wygadany.  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Rowerzysta (41) – wysportowany rowerzysta, konkretny, rzeczowy  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

5.Paweł (44) – alkoholik i przemocowiec, wyżyłowany, zaniedbany zarost, krótkie włosy. 
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

6.Lekarz (61) – konkretny i rzeczowy lekarz, zadbany 
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

7. Damian Wisłocki (28) – wysportowany, groźna aparycja, gangster. Krótki zarost  – konieczne prawo jazdy
Data: 27 i 30.10
Stawka: 1600 / 1702

Chętnych Panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
We have a SHELL job we are casting for specifically on Thursday, 8th October 2026

Please see roles below:

JHB Asian Mom
JHB Asian Leo
JHB Asian Dad

Please have a close look at role descriptions, JHB Talent will need to self tape but if you have talent in CPT please state this under provisions and we will invite to studio.                                               
JHB Asian Mum
Description
__________________________
30- 40 yrs

Mum is the kind of parent who quietly helps fuel Leos imagination.
She gives him the freedom to explore, create and get lost in his own world, while always being there with warmth, encouragement and a playful spirit.
She has a natural way of making everyday moments feel special and brings a genuine sense of joy and creativity into Leos life.

Mum is a grounding force that brings a sense of warmth and comfort.

In casting, we need to get a sense of how our parents interact with children.
You can spot right away if the performer has that mum or dad energy with how they play, and how they redirect the kids on their own.
Gender
Female
Playing Age
30 to 40 years
Appearance
Asian
Rate
R10,000 day fee
View And Respond To This Role
JHB Asian Dad
Description
__________________________
30-40 yrs

Dad is the kind of parent who turns simple drives with Leo into something they both look forward to, whether it is heading out to a forested road or just around the
neighbourhood.

Their adventures often begin with a stop at a Shell forecourt, and Dad has quietly noticed how much Leo has absorbed from those moments, especially the Click. Shtick. Vroom. ritual he has created from the familiar sounds of filling up.

He has a calm, grounding presence that gives Leo the freedom to let his imagination run wild,
while still being right there with him, ready to tap into the kid in himself and share in the joy of the moment.
Dad shares his love of cars and always supports Leos curiosity and imagination.

items.text:
Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 13.10-16.10.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Dokładny termin i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

3. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

SAY HELLO TO MY TEAM!
MY PRAYER WARRIORS!
I'm Still Yo Mama..... Tosha McDoniel. Valerie Ireland ,, Keisha Keisha , Molly Ellen Van Rees, Roshall Rawnet Jordan and not shown is Deborah W.

WHEN GOD SENDS YOU COVERING, YOU DON'T HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT WHO'S COMING! 💜🙏🏽
Let me tell y'all something about these women right here! THEY DO NOT PLAY ABOUT ME! And when I tell you I am grateful, words cannot even begin to express it! ❤️
During my last show, I was a one-woman production ON and OFF the stage! I changed my own clothes, switched my own wigs, fixed my own makeup, and probably needed to stop and pray for myself between scenes! 😂 Honey, I was the actress, wardrobe department, makeup artist, hairstylist, and emergency response team! ALL IN ONE! 😂
And let me just say this right here: There wasn't anybody sneaking folks up the stairs OR slipping them through the elevators! NOT ON THEIR WATCH! 😂 Honey, the stairs were covered, the elevators were covered, and I believe if somebody had tried coming through the ceiling, somebody would've been standing there with a Bible! 😂
Now, that's ALL I'm going to say about THAT, because God can shake somebody up about me a whole lot better than I ever could! And I don't have to lift a finger when God has already assigned the covering! 🙌🏽
I prayed for a successful show, but God gave me something greater. He showed me what it feels like to be COVERED, PROTECTED, SUPPORTED, and LOVED!
Some people show up for the spotlight. Others show up because God assigned them to your life. And when you know the difference, you learn to treasure the ones who came with an assignment. 💜

"For He shall give His angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways." — Psalm 91:11 (KJV)
To my ladies, my audience, and everyone who helped make I'm Still Yo Mama unforgettable, I LOVE YOU, I APPRECIATE YOU, AND I THANK GOD FOR YOU!
The show may be over, but the testimony is STILL being written! 🙌🏽💜
#ImStillYoMama #GodSentMyCovering #MyDivasDontPlay #CoveredByPrayer #LuvnCrockettsEntertainment #ButGod

In diesem Video gibt es Einblicke in das [#Filmrecht](https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/filmrecht?__cft__[0]=AZiyUSboLYII24y2YvtL_1Zka-qbd5u_Al_t079is7fVyZViF7MdluIhT3pdFvG307Iqq3ciIHUpCyNPlGsMl27iPlDO2wJoS_hSxZT4D-bmEBkUJ1Xa3EnjZHWHhh8xIuMbB1KvyreksWBCEvSFwjBCC1r3abEp6qAJd-NzBtjo0KtDQwK4iSe3nBV-2t4I&__tn__=*NK-R), wie insb. das Urheberrecht, Filmförderung, die Rechtseinräumung der Mitwirkenden an den Filmproduzenten, die Verträge mit Cast und Crew, Bedeutung der GEMA für die Filmmusik, Allgemeines Persönlichkeitsrecht und Verträge zur Verwertung (Verleih und Vertrieb). Der Vortrag richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger und Profis, welche ihre Kenntnisse auffrischen wollen.

[https://youtu.be/_srM6Kuj4M0](https://youtu.be/_srM6Kuj4M0)

sharedPost.text:
🎤✨ Jasmin Spiske bei der Julian Schlager Welt! ✨🎤

Wir durften beim Interview beim Lichtkegel die liebe Jasmin Spiske kennenlernen und ein wunderschönes Gespräch mit ihr führen. 🥰❤️

Dabei hat sie uns von ihrer neuen Single „Warum denn nicht“ erzählt. Es war wirklich schön, dich kennenlernen zu dürfen, liebe Jasmin! 🎶❤️

📺 Freut euch schon bald auf den kompletten Beitrag vom Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb in Dischingen! 🎤✨

Dort präsentiert Jasmin Spiske ihren tollen Song „Warum denn nicht“. Außerdem erwarten euch viele weitere großartige Künstlerinnen und Künstler, die ihre eigenen Songs oder wunderschöne Coverversionen präsentieren. 🎶👏

Ein musikalisches Erlebnis voller Emotionen, toller Stimmen und schöner Momente! ❤️🎵

Der komplette Beitrag erscheint bald auf unserem YouTube-Kanal JSW Fernsehen und bei OK Merseburg TV. Seid gespannt! 📺

🎶 Und vieles mehr bei der Julian Schlager Welt!

❤️ Abonniert unsere Kanäle, folgt uns und lasst gerne ein Herz da. Wir freuen uns über eure Unterstützung!

Schöne Grüße
Euer Julian Wien 🎤❤️

Jasmin Spiske Julian Wien Entertainment Julian Wien Musik macht glücklich Sigrid Mannes Pit Focke Iris Trevisan Raffael König Sänger/in gesucht DE/AT/CH Melissa Mannes-Nagel Der Wünschewagen
